bugs_found: transfer is not atomic: account_from is debited before account_to is credited, so malformed account_to.balance or incompatible amount can leave balances inconsistent
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, allowing type errors or inconsistent behavior with floats/other numeric types
compound_interest accepts negative principal, producing nonsensical negative-money results
integer casts silently truncate years and compounds_per_year when given non-integer numeric inputs
fx_convert does not validate that exchange rates are positive/nonzero, allowing negative or zero conversions
functions do not reject non-finite Decimal values such as NaN or Infinity explicitly
